claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr / DiceExprDelta — ability_modifier flat addend
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The heal amount is 'Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier'. DiceExpr.flat is a fixed integer (number). There is no variant that references an ability score modifier at runtime. A new shape is needed — e.g. flat as a union of number | { kind: 'ability_modifier'; ability: Ability; minimum?: number } — or a new DiceAmount variant with an explicit modifier field.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap — ability_modifier_minimum variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The use count is 'Wisdom modifier (minimum once)'. UseCountCap supports only 'fixed' (static integer) or ThresholdTiers<number> (level-based tier schedule). Neither can express an ability-score-based cap. A new variant is needed: e.g. { kind: 'ability_modifier'; ability: Ability; minimum: number }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once)
